arguments.code:
# Find most played song by artist 'Velvet Echo' (artist_id=25)
artist_id = 25
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_songs = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.search_songs(artist_id=artist_id, query='', sort_by='-play_count', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('total songs', len(all_songs))
# compute max play_count
max_play = None
candidates = []
for s in all_songs:
    pc = s.get('play_count', 0.0)
    if max_play is None or pc > max_play:
        max_play = pc
        candidates = [s]
    elif pc == max_play:
        candidates.append(s)
print('max_play_count', max_play)
print('candidate_count', len(candidates))
# tie-breaker: alphabetical title then song_id
candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: (x.get('title',''), x.get('song_id',0)))
print('top_candidates:', [{'song_id':c['song_id'],'title':c['title'],'play_count':c.get('play_count')} for c in candidates_sorted[:10]])
print('selected_title', candidates_sorted[0]['title'])
